remainingDifferences: V187 mock handset has a one-point outline and rounded device corners. Flutter uses actual viewport bounds.
Confirm height is up to 8.31 points taller in Flutter at 430 × 932 because of device bottom safe area. At 375 × 667 the difference is at most 0.31 points.
Native tab bar is 11 points higher at 430 × 932 and nine points lower at 375 × 667. Preview retains a 16-point card-to-tab gap.
V187 missing local prototype portrait images paint initials. Flutter detached fixtures have synthetic portrait silhouettes.
Guardian and Profiles layouts beneath the scrim use existing native fixtures, including an extra seeded Guardian Journey and different pagination dot styling.
Settings uses translucent ivory panels with floating shadows in Flutter. Minor heading and row spacing and seeded labels differ from the prototype.
Filters Flutter is lighter across the card, with a stronger selected-segment shadow and more upright inactive segment text. Profiles CTA footer uses native gold-ink treatment.
Both compact Preview Details captures crop the lower request at rest. Flutter permits vertical scroll inside the shared card to expose the whole button and show the toast.
Preview Flutter makes the selected Profile tab underline and seeded My ZYRA notification visible using the app tab bar. V187 paints no notification dot in this scenario.
V187 paints only the Details page in its own-preview renderer. Flutter supports the LOCK21 V3 tap-through photo pages.
